text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
E-e-excuse me, Rob Roy! Um, would you
happen
to be looking for a bookmark?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-well, I was in town the other day
when I just
happened to spot you ahead
of me, and you
dropped your bookmark
in that very same
moment...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I picked it up right away and tried to
catch up to
you, but I lost you in the
crowd! S-so I held onto
it until I could
give it back...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, so that's where it went! Thank you
for
keeping it safe for me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But I'm surprised you recognized me just
from
seeing my back. There's not much
about me that
stands out...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Your dark, shiny ears and your tail were
shining a
glorious light! And you looked
like a great scholar
holding your book!
How could anyone miss such a
splendid
Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wh... what? I don't know what you're
talking
about. What light? A scholar?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You flatter me! Hehe. ♪ "The wise
scholar of
light" sounds like a heroic
tale!
